content.text: Gɑri wee yi yi kɑ Tiri yɑ̃.
Bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ ɡoo nimkuu bɑkɑsu sɔɔ,
i wuri koowo, domi bɛɛn wuu ɡɑ kɑm kuɑ.
Yɛnusu kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ, duu yeru mɑɑ sɑri.
Sɑɑ Kitimun tem diyɑ sɑ yen lɑbɑɑri nuɑ.
I mɑrio bɛrum sɔ̃,
bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡooru ɡiɑ
mi Sidonin tenkubɑ bɑ rɑ sɑre.
Eɡibitiɡibu bɑ dobi yeemɔ dɑɑ te mɔ̀ Niluɔ
mɑ tenkubɑ bɑ ye dwemɔ bɑ dɔrɑmɔ
mɑ bɑ ɑre bɛkɛ dimɔ.
Mɑ yɑm mi, n kuɑ bwesenu kpuron yɑburu.
Sidoni, kɑɑ sekuru wɑ,
domi Tiri, nim wɔ̃kun wuu dɑmɡuu, ɡɑ ɡeruɑ ɡɑ nɛɛ,
ɡɑ ǹ mɑrubun wɑhɑlɑ ɡɑɑ wɑɑre, ɡɑ ǹ mɑɑ mɑrure.
Gɑ ǹ bii ɑluwɑɑsi bɔm kɛ̃ɛre,
ɡɑ ǹ mɑɑ bii wɔndiɑ seeyɑre.
Eɡibitiɡibu bɑ̀ n nuɑ mɑ Tiri yɑ wɔrumɑ,
bɑ koo diiri.
Bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡooru ɡiɑ,
i wuri koowo i kɑ dɑ Tɑɑsisiɔ.
Bɛɛn wuu ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɑɑ yellun di
ɡè sɔɔ i rɑ nuku dobu ko, ɡerɑ mi?
Tiri yerɑ mi?
Yèn tɔmbu bɑ dɑ bɑ tem tukumɡibu kɑmiɑ?
Wɑrɑ u ye kpuron himbɑ yi Tirin sɔ̃,
ye, ye yɑ rɑ yen wiruɡibu swĩi tem tukumɔ.
Yen tenkubɑ bɑ kuɑ sinɑ bibu.
Mɑ bɑ bɛɛrɛ mɔ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ u ye yi,
u kɑ be bɑ tii sue kɑwɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ,
kpɑ bu be bɑ rɑɑ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ ɡɛm.
Bɛɛ Tɑɑsisiɡibu i tɛrio bɛɛn tem sɔɔ
nɡe mɛ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Nilu tɑ̀ n nim yibɑ mu rɑ tɛrie.
Domi yoo sɔmɑ kpɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u win nɔmɑ dɛmiɑ nim wɔ̃kun berɑ ɡiɑ.
Mɑ u derɑ sinɑmbɑ diirɑ.
U derɑ Kɑnɑnin ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɑmɡinu nu wɔrukɑ.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, bɛɛ Sidoniɡibu i ǹ mɑɑ nuku dobu wɑsi.
Domi bɑ bɛɛ dɑm dɔre nɡe wɔndiɑ wi u kun durɔ yɛ̃.
Bɑɑ ì n seewɑ i dɑ Kitimun temɔ,
min tii i ǹ wɛ̃rɑbu wɑsi.
I Bɑbiloniɡibu mɛɛrio.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Asiriɡibu bɑ bu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ Tiri wɔri bɑ tɑrusi,
bɑ yen sinɑ kpɑɑnu kɔsukɑ,
mɑ ye kpuro yɑ kuɑ bɑnsu.
I wuri koowo bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ ɡoo
nimkuu bɑkɑsu sɔɔ.
Domi Tirin wuu dɑmɡuu ɡe, ɡɑ wɔrumɑ.

content: Bɑ koo Tirin ɡɑri duɑri n kɑ ko wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru nɡe sinɑ boko turon bɑndun tɛɛbun sɑkɑ. Adɑmɑ yen biru yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kurɔ sɑkɑrɑ wi bɑ womu doke bɑ mɔ̀,

content.text: ɑ mɔrɔku suo ɑ n soomɔ ɑ kɑ wuu sikerenɑ,
wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑre kurɔ sɑkɑrɑ wi bɑ duɑri.
A ɡu soowo nɡe mɛ wunɛn yɛ̃rɑ nɛ,
ɑ n kɑ womu dɑbi dɑbinu mɔ̀,
kpɑ bu wunɛn ɡɑri yɑɑyɑ.

content: Wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔku ten biru, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo de Tiri yu mɑɑ wurɑ yen yellun tenkuru sɔɔ te bɑ mɔ̀ kɑ tɑki. Kpɑ yu kɑ hɑnduniɑn tɔmbu kpuro ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke.

Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ yen ɑrumɑni kɑ yen ɑre yi bɑ wɑ kɑ tɑki ɡurɑmɔ bu mɛnnɑ ben tiin sɔ̃. Bɑ koo ye kpuro Yinni Gusunɔ yiiyɑwɑ kpɑ yɑ n sɑ̃ɑ be bɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔɡiɑ, kpɑ bu dĩɑnu wɑ bu di bu debu, kpɑ bu yɑ̃ɑ burɑnu wɑ bu doke.
